notes: New name: On Paper is now Liftprint, with a new fingerprint-and-barbell icon. Your data stays exactly where it was.
Tap the ⓘ next to any exercise for a guide: what it is, what it builds, real-life examples, whether it helps your dunk, your best, and the muscles worked.
Rewarding animations: confetti on PRs and finished workouts, sparkles on every set, numbers counting up, smooth screen transitions.
Feeding your pet is now a little show: the snack flies in, they munch, cheer and fill up, with confetti when you hit a goal. Pets blink now too.
